title: Register the accepted switch_pt executor in the v2 vocabulary

evidence.fact: The accepted parent overlay supplies the switch_pt ExecuteAbilityEffect dispatcher and Layer-7e executor for self, a bare creature target, and each creature.
Parser reachability is closed over backend/cards registry entries, so registration—not another Map pattern—is the missing bridge.
Primitive has only Executor and ShapeTest fields; the frozen literal must be extended only by regEffect from a registry_topic init file.
A complete small registry_topic.go example shows the required package, init, regEffect, and Primitive form.
The accepted overlay exposes the exact switch_pt dispatcher and its executor contract; this ticket may reference it but must not edit it.
The complete local test convention includes imports, CardDefinition construction, intPtr, game setup, and drainStack.
The existing v2 spell EffectAtom sequence forwards effect name, value, and target to the shared ability executor; registration must fit this path without converter work.

required_behavior: Add exactly one switch_pt v2 Primitive through backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go using the shown regEffect convention.
Set Executor to the existing game/ability_effects.go switch_pt dispatcher and ShapeTest to the new TestShape_SwitchPT name.

Add one shape test that proves switch_pt is registered and that a spell EffectAtom sequence with a bare creature target reaches the existing shared execution path. The parent test remains authority for Layer-7e semantics.
Do not edit parser, converter, frozen registry literal, or backend/game. Do not add another primitive.
gates: git status --porcelain adds or changes only backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go and backend/cards/shape_switch_pt_test.go

execution.selection_reason: Claude receives the exact registry, dispatcher, converter, and local test interfaces requested in v1. It cannot commit, push, deploy, or mutate live tickets.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. A request to change parser, converter, or Layer-7e execution is a separate TicketSpec.
